dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: You gave Linling the manifest, I trust? Has she headed off to work yet?

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: I won't hide it from you. Each piece of cargo on that manifest was one that I picked out specially.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: As for their numbers and other details, I have had them in hand for a while now, as well.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Like I said, this is a test, not an actual job.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: I hope she takes this seriously and realigns her priorities. At least, then, those nights of midnight oil that I burned won't go to waste...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: It never rains, but it pours...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: After that huge incident at the Rite of Descension, the streets have been filling up with Millelith.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: The tension in the air hangs over us like a shroud. Our doors aren't closed, but...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: You know as well as I do how Liyue often does business with other nations, and how many people from every nation live in our city.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: They've brought us prosperity, and a fair amount of cultural exchange, too.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: But this incident has caused many such people to be very ill at ease.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: I've been making preparations to try and calm people down, but with the situation as it is, I don't know where to begin looking for people good at international relations.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Hmm, wait a moment. Traveler, you've been to many different parts of the world already, haven't you? You must be good at speaking to people from other nations.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Could I trouble you, then, to help me calm some of our guests down?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll see this done.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Thank you, you're a big help. Now, I need to go and settle some other matters.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll give this a try...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Well, then... please do. I really have no one else to turn to.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Please retain a copy of your approved mooring license application form for your records... Hey! What are you doing!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you up to?

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: I'm working, can't you see? I deal with all vessels entering and exiting the harbor, including mooring and customs procedures.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Please don't disturb me if you have no business here. The restricted goods approval form... Needs to be signed by a Millelith Sergeant...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Didn't know talking to yourself counts as working.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: ...Can you stop annoying me? I'm working out what I need to do next.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: ...Aiya, now I've lost my train of thought...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to it. Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: *grunts*

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Ah yes... And the potable water replenishment forms for all vessels need to be processed at the warehouse...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Hi there! May the flames of wisdom spread to all, and never be extinguished!

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: This is the Lantern Rite Gala. I'm from the Maritime Authority, is there something I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What can you tell me about Lantern Rite?

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Lantern Rite is an annual festival everyone in Liyue celebrates. It takes place during the first full moon of the year.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: During the five-day festival, people pray for peace, ward off evil spirits, and watch the lanterns. We believe the fire's light keeps wisdom alive, and guides fallen heroes home along the sea.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: It's a popular tradition to make Xiao Lanterns and release them into the night sky.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: The lanterns light the path for the souls of our fallen heroes as they travel by cover of night. We hope the lanterns will guide them back home so they can be reunited with us here.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Of course, I enjoy the time off work the most! Haha, I hope you thoroughly enjoy yourselves and participate in all the festivities on offer.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are Xiao Lanterns?

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Good question. As you might have guessed, you can't have a Lantern Rite without lanterns!

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Usually home-made, they consist of a paper frame with a wick inside. After lighting the wick, Plaustrite is inserted to make it float.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Before releasing it into the air, people will write their wishes on wish sticks and insert them into the lantern. The lantern then carries their wishes off into the night sky.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Liyue may be well known for its mining industry, but fortunately, being surrounded by rocks hasn't turned people's hearts to stone...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Maybe it's because we also live off the sea. That romantic idea of the gentle sea breeze has found its way into our hearts... Haha.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Would you care to try making your own Xiao Lantern? After all, it's not every day you get to be in Liyue during Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not right now, thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Okay. Well, enjoy your time here.
